answer: Route every new agent through a staked onboarding jetty: to dock, it must lock tokens for 30 days while a random panel of veteran agents audits its first 20 tasks. Agents sharing hosting, wallets, or timing fingerprints are clustered and must re-stake per cluster member. A sybil farm then needs capital multiplied by every hollow identity, all frozen at once, and one failed audit slashes the whole knoll of linked stakes.
